title: Incudo container manifest
description: The `manifest.json` at the root of a `.incu` save or a `.incuset` content bundle (ADR 0012). It is the first thing a reader parses, so it carries everything needed to decide whether to go on: the format version, what is inside, and a checksum per entry.

kind.description: What this container holds: a character (.incu) or a content bundle (.incuset).

systemId.description: Required for a character container. The system definition itself is not embedded — it comes from the app (ADR 0012).

characterKind.description: Which of the system's kinds the character is, duplicated here so a reader can tell without unpacking character.json.

name.description: Display name, so a file browser or an import list can show something before unpacking.

elementCount.description: How many elements content.json carries. Typically 60–200 for a character out of a 12,000-element corpus.

assets.description: Paths of the files under assets/, so a reader can list them without scanning the archive.

sources.description: Provenance: which sources contributed the embedded content, at which versions. Enough to offer "Xanathar's has been updated since you built this — refresh?" when those sources are available.

integrity.description: SHA-256 of each entry, as "sha256-<hex>", keyed by path within the container. Detects a truncated download or a hand-edit that went wrong; it is not a signature and proves nothing about who wrote the file.

additionalProperties.patternDescription: must look like "sha256-" followed by 64 hex digits

generator.description: What wrote this, e.g. "incudo-cli/0.0.1". Useful in a bug report, ignored on read.
